name: cx_overview
description: Show one directory level or a source file outline. Output is bounded to 50KB/2000 lines.

noTests.description: Exclude test files and test symbols

promptSnippet: Inspect a directory or file structure without reading full source
promptGuidelines: Use cx_overview before reading a whole source file when only its structure is needed.

name: cx_symbols
description: Search repository symbols by typed filters. name is a glob (for example *Material*); scope is matched against the complete qualified name (for example ANGE::MaterialRegistry::*). Requires a filter or kinds=true.

name.description: Symbol-name glob. Use *Material* for related-name discovery; Material is an exact match.

scope.description: Glob matched against the complete qualified name. Use ANGE::*, ANGE::MaterialRegistry::*, or an exact name such as ANGE::MaterialRegistry::load; a parent without trailing ::* does not match members.

noTests.description: Exclude test files and test symbols

promptSnippet: Search identifiers and symbol metadata across the project
promptGuidelines: Use cx_symbols for identifier-oriented discovery; name is a glob (use *Material* for related names), and scope matches the complete qualified name (use ANGE::* or ANGE::MaterialRegistry::*). Use grep for raw strings, logs, SQL, routes, and generated text.

name: cx_definition
description: Read a symbol implementation body; defaults to role=definition. scope must match the complete qualified name, using ::* when selecting members of a parent scope.

name.description: Lexical symbol name, not a qualified name

scope.description: Glob matched against the complete qualified name. Use ANGE::*, ANGE::MaterialRegistry::*, or an exact name such as ANGE::MaterialRegistry::load; a parent without trailing ::* does not match members.

noTests.description: Exclude test files and test symbols

promptSnippet: Read one symbol body instead of a whole file
promptGuidelines: Use cx_definition to read one implementation before falling back to a full-file read; scope matches the complete qualified name, so member lookups need patterns such as ANGE::MaterialRegistry::* or an exact qualified name.

name: cx_references
description: Find syntax-classified occurrences by lexical identifier. Qualified names are rejected; use cx_callers/cx_callees with scope for qualified call evidence. This is not compiler type resolution.

name.description: Lexical identifier such as load; qualified names such as ANGE::MaterialRegistry::load are rejected. Use cx_callers/cx_callees with scope for qualified call evidence.

noTests.description: Exclude test files and test symbols

promptSnippet: Find syntax-classified references to a symbol
promptGuidelines: Use cx_references for syntax-classified occurrences and pass a lexical identifier such as load, never a qualified name; use cx_callers/cx_callees with scope for qualified call evidence. Do not treat unresolved edges as resolved.

name: cx_callers
description: Find one-hop callers, preserving unresolved targets and candidates.

scope.description: Glob matched against the complete qualified name. Use ANGE::*, ANGE::MaterialRegistry::*, or an exact name such as ANGE::MaterialRegistry::load; a parent without trailing ::* does not match members.

noTests.description: Exclude test files and test symbols

promptSnippet: Find direct callers with resolution evidence
promptGuidelines: Use cx_callers/cx_callees for one-hop call evidence; do not treat unresolved edges as resolved.

name: cx_callees
description: Find one-hop callees; ambiguous symbols are not guessed and no multi-hop depth is available.

name.description: Lexical symbol identifier whose body should be examined

scope.description: Glob matched against the complete qualified name. Use ANGE::*, ANGE::MaterialRegistry::*, or an exact name such as ANGE::MaterialRegistry::load; a parent without trailing ::* does not match members.

noTests.description: Exclude test files and test symbols

promptSnippet: Find direct callees with resolution evidence
promptGuidelines: Use cx_callers/cx_callees for one-hop call evidence; do not treat unresolved edges as resolved.

name: cx_map
description: Create a bounded repository map preserving ranking and import warnings.
promptSnippet: Orient within repository subsystems and import edges
promptGuidelines: Use cx_map for bounded repository orientation, not as a runtime dependency graph.

name: cx_refresh
description: Explicitly refresh changed paths, or verify the whole project when paths is empty.
promptSnippet: Refresh the cx index after edits when generation proof is needed
promptGuidelines: Use cx_refresh after edits when the next decision requires proof that the current index generation includes those paths.

name: cx_impact
description: Analyze bounded multi-hop reverse call impact for one exact function site. Returns shortest supported/possible witnesses, unresolved frontiers, coverage and independent traversal/output limits; not compiler or runtime proof.

name.description: Lexical function name; use scope/file/site selectors to choose exactly one root

scope.description: Glob matched against the complete qualified name. Use ANGE::*, ANGE::MaterialRegistry::*, or an exact name such as ANGE::MaterialRegistry::load; a parent without trailing ::* does not match members.

detail.description: compact (default) preserves primary evidence; full includes repeated raw paths/matches/hunks

noTests.description: Exclude test files and test symbols

promptSnippet: Trace multi-hop impact with source witnesses and uncertainty
promptGuidelines: Use cx_impact for multi-hop reverse call questions, not routine body reads. Select one root with file/scope/site; preserve supported versus possible paths and unresolved frontiers. Unknown totals and traversal limits are not a safety verdict; snapshot guards output pagination.

name: cx_changes
description: Compare tracked Git/working snapshots, preserving old/new symbols and file-level/non-source changes. Optional impact is evaluated separately before and after. Does not run project commands or tests.

detail.description: compact (default) preserves primary evidence; full includes repeated raw paths/matches/hunks

noTests.description: Exclude test files and test symbols

promptSnippet: Locate changes on both sides and optionally analyze their impact
promptGuidelines: Use cx_changes for tracked Git changes with old/new symbol evidence. Default compares raw working bytes to HEAD; staged and commit modes are explicit. Optional impact has separate before/after snapshots. It never executes project tests or proves behavioral safety.

name: cx_context
description: Find task-relevant source by exact names, paths, subwords and body/comment/string evidence. Bounded original excerpts and byte-aware pagination; no popularity filler or semantic-search guarantee.

query.description: Task words, identifier or path. Lexical retrieval, not semantic search

detail.description: compact (default) preserves primary evidence; full includes repeated raw paths/matches/hunks

noTests.description: Exclude test files and test symbols

promptSnippet: Retrieve a bounded, source-backed task context
promptGuidelines: Use cx_context when task words are known but the relevant symbols/files are not. It retrieves lexical evidence and bounded original text, not semantic confidence. Prefer cx_definition for a known body; preserve missing evidence and budget disclosures.
